prompt:
A desktop web app screen (landscape, about 16:10) for Grocy Next, a self-hosted household app for stock, shopping, meals and chores, rendered edge to edge with crisp readable text, no browser window, device or desk around it. The visitor job: glance at what is on hand and what to use first, then plan. Frame: left navigation with the "Grocy Next" wordmark, destinations Stock (selected), Shopping (badge 3), Meals, Chores, then Settings at the bottom and a small "Review 2" entry for pending assistant proposals.

Real content. Today is Sunday 8 Nov 2026. Header "Stock" with a search field "Search products", filter tabs "All 11", "Due soon 3", "Expired 1", "Below min 2", a location select "All locations", and one primary button "Purchase". Rows (name, location, amount, best-before): Spinach, Fridge, 200 g, expired 6 Nov · Greek yogurt, Fridge, 1 pc, 10 Nov · Whole milk, Fridge, 1000 ml, 11 Nov · Chicken thighs, Freezer, 600 g, 12 Nov · Cheddar, Fridge, 250 g, 14 Nov · Eggs, Fridge, 4 pcs (min 6), 19 Nov · Basmati rice, Pantry, 400 g (min 1000 g), no date · Coffee beans, Pantry, 800 g, 12 Jan 2027 · Canned tomatoes, Pantry, 4 pcs, 13 Mar 2027. Each row has one quiet "Use" action.

Style references (if you can fetch them, use them as style inspiration only, adapted into a real working product, do not copy their layout or content): https://impeccable.style/worlds/cards/signals-instruments-split-flap-concourse.webp and https://impeccable.style/worlds/cards/signals-instruments-split-flap-concourse-hero.webp.
